quotes.text: "new folder dialog should have reasonable width"

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The owned attempt adds a 40ch minimum width, fixed 200px document height and viewport-sized body, while removing the test head's new-folder persisted-state reset. Accepted source later uses 22rem/18rem minimums and no body viewport dimensions. Its focused menu callback checks at least 235 by 120 after the dialog gains focus. Those are distinct geometry/test phases; neither the patch subject nor this static comparison proves the intermittent failure was cured.
title: The new-folder sizing attempt changes both initial geometry and persisted-state setup
